Title: 485185-2026: Italy – Construction of stadiums – PROGRAMME FOR “BUILDING RENOVATION, UPGRADING AND ADAPTATION OF THE ARTURO COLLANA SPORTS COMPLEX” IN NAPLES
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Renovation of a stadium and sports complex in Naples is highly relevant for sbp, since stadiums and large-volume sports buildings are among our core interests. The location in Italy (outside the DACH region) slightly reduces the priority.
titel: Programme for the structural renovation, upgrading and adaptation of the Arturo Collana sports complex in Naples
kurzbeschreibung: In Naples, the Arturo Collana sports complex will be comprehensively renovated, upgraded and adapted to current requirements as part of a four-year programme. The contract covers construction works as well as engineering and architectural services and will be implemented via a framework agreement with a single economic operator.
wettbewerb_art: Open tender procedure for construction works as well as engineering and architectural services (framework agreement with a single operator)
gewinner_rolle: Construction company / general contractor in a joint venture (RTI)
gewinner_kontakt:
Contract value: 42578279.19 EUR (excluding VAT)
Address: via Campana n. 233, 80078 Pozzuoli (NA), Italy
E-mail: opuscostruzioni@pec.it
Telephone: +39 0815242179
projektbeteiligte:
- Contracting authority: Agenzia Regionale Universiadi per lo Sport (regional public body), Via S.Lucia n.81, 80132 Napoli, Italy, e-mail: aru2019@pec.regione.campania.it, tel.: +39 081 0171228
- Contractor / winner: RTI OPUS COSTRUZIONI SPA (construction company / general contractor), via Campana n. 233, 80078 Pozzuoli (NA), Italy, e-mail: opuscostruzioni@pec.it, tel.: +39 0815242179
- Review body: TAR Campania - Napoli (administrative court), Piazza municipio 64, 80133 Napoli, Italy
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Sports complex / stadium-like facility, fundamentally a very good fit with the sbp portfolio
- Combination of construction works and engineering/architectural services, potentially including structural design
- Larger project volume (~48.5 million EUR), more complex renovation and adaptation measures likely
- Location outside the DACH region but within Europe; cooperation more likely via the GC/RTI than directly with the public contracting authority
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Relevant sports building with significant volume, potentially complex structures (stands, roofs)
- Project is located in Italy, checking engineer services under the German system are not directly applicable
- Framework agreement has already been awarded to a single operator; no formal tender for independent checking services currently apparent
- Possibility for expert second opinions or specialist consulting via the GC/planner cannot be ruled out
baukosten_erklaerung: Read from the notice: estimated value/maximum value of the framework agreement excluding VAT as an approximation for cost groups 300-400
naechste_schritte: Consider contacting RTI OPUS COSTRUZIONI SPA (opuscostruzioni@pec.it, tel. +39 0815242179) to offer services as a specialist for structural design and special roof/stand structures for partial tasks or subcontractor services; in parallel, request project documents from the Agenzia Regionale Universiadi per lo Sport (aru2019@pec.regione.campania.it) in order to assess the scope of structures and possible interfaces for sbp in more detail.
notes: Mixed contract (construction + engineering and architectural services) within a four-year framework agreement with a single economic operator; the exact allocation of planning services (including structural design) is not specified in the TED text. The project is a renovation/restructuring of an existing sports complex (Arturo Collana) in Naples, potentially involving interventions in stands, roof structures and sports infrastructure. Award criteria: 80% technical quality, 20% price, which indicates qualitative requirements and a focus on design/technical aspects.
